description: This file defines the PopulateComboValues class responsible for managing and populating combo box (picklist) values in the vtiger CRM system, including creating tables, inserting values, and handling non-picklist data.

classes.name: PopulateComboValues
classes.description: A class to handle population and management of combo box values in vtiger CRM, including creating tables, inserting values, and setting non-editable options.

methods.name: insertComboValues
methods.description: Inserts a set of values into a specified picklist table and associates them with roles.

methods.name: create_tables
methods.description: Creates picklist tables and populates them with default values at startup.

methods.name: create_nonpicklist_tables
methods.description: Creates tables for non-standard picklist values.
